fusions.name: Slow Cinch
fusions.desc: A slow heavy blow that deals 40 damage as a guaranteed critical hit and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Dragging Weight
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 10 damage, with a 50% chance each of being [Stalled] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Settled Mend
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Rested Limbs
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, you deal 30% more physical damage for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
